description: The SOAR Optical Imager (SOI) is an optical mini-mosaic imager mounted at the bent Cassegrain focus of the 4.1-meter SOAR telescope, utilizing two 2k x 4k CCDs and a wide complement of broad-band and narrow-band filters.
facility_description: The Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) 4.1-meter Telescope is situated atop Cerro Pachón in Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab.
notes: SOI was the first-light optical imager for SOAR. Filter curves are distributed on NOIRLab/SOAR websites without an open licence grant.
